info.title: Videoflow Product API
info.description: Machine-readable contract for the storyboard workspace. The existing AgentRuntime thread API is documented separately.

201.description: Created storyboard and optional asset-copy report.

post.description: Creates a new storyboard immediately after the source. Copies the script, storyboard-owned media records, asset sections and bindings, and workspace nodes. Stored media objects and project assets remain shared; conversations, proposals, and generation jobs are not copied.

204.description: Workspace node and its descendants deleted

post.description: Creates or returns the storyboard-owned media placeholder for an image or video workspace object. Repeated calls return the same media item.

put.description: Stores JPEG, PNG, WebP, MP4 or MOV bytes in local media storage and replaces the object's current preview. Maximum body size: 100 MB.

204.description: Section deleted after applying the explicit binding action.
Binding removed; shared asset and media remain.

200.description: Reference-copy report. No asset or object-store file is copied.
Fresh short-lived thumbnail and preview access.
Server-approved image and video generation models and capabilities.
Latest workspace thread binding, or null when the storyboard has no conversation yet.
All workspace thread bindings for the storyboard, newest first.
Applied proposal and optional atomically-created generation job.

StoryboardWindow.description: Storyboard window centered on the requested anchor.

WorkspaceNodeList.description: Flat, position-ordered workspace tree nodes for one storyboard.

AssetSectionList.description: Complete section tree for a storyboard.

targetSectionId.description: Required exactly when includeSectionStructure is false.
